title: V1 Core Bookkeeping - compliance matrix

milestones.M1: Ledger core: chart of accounts, period states, PostingService, journals, general ledger, trial balance
milestones.M2: Contacts as customers/suppliers, VAT foundation, sales, credit notes, receipts
milestones.M4: Bank accounts, statement import, transfers, charges, interest, reconciliation
milestones.M5: Profit and loss, balance sheet, drill-down to documents, controls and alerts
milestones.M6: V1 UI slices behind feature flags (DEC-002)

acceptance: A milestone is accepted by the product owner on an acceptance package: commit SHA, CI run (every job), test results, migrations, security/permission checks, matrix changes, known limitations (DEC-007).
